annotations.title: How many tokens launched on Base since a block (free)

description: Free, no payment needed. Counts the pools created against WETH, ETH or USDC on Uniswap v2, v3, v4 and Aerodrome on Base since `since_block` (or in the last `minutes`) and how many distinct tokens they are for, by DEX, with the latest block. Counts only: the token addresses, names and risk verdicts come with the paid new_token_launches, whose ready-to-send call is included when there is something new. Built for polling bots: peek for free, pay only when new_tokens > 0. Rate-limited per client.

minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes (1-360, default 60). Ignored when since_block is given.

since_block.description: Only pools created after this Base block: pass the previous answer's latest_block when polling (at most 6 hours back).

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
